signal_to_noise.rationale: No noise, because there is no signal: the anchored neutral 3 for an empty test suite.

findings.issue: No test script, runner, or test files anywhere in the app; all risky logic (filters, pagination, sorting, URL state) ships unguarded.
findings.suggestion: Add node:test (no new dependency) unit tests for format.ts, pageUrl/filter logic, speciesCards, and the method-order comparator; wire an npm run test script.

findings.issue: The filter/search/pagination pipeline (type-slot set matching, generation membership, page clamping, slice math) is untested; a refactor could silently return wrong pages or counts.
findings.suggestion: Extract the pipeline into a pure function taking (speciesIndex, typeData, generationData, query) and unit-test the edge cases: empty q, page beyond total, NaN page, type matching second slot.

findings.issue: Per-Pokémon fetch failures are swallowed (.catch(() => null)), silently dropping cards and skewing the '<count> Pokémon' totals derived from cards.length (moves/[name].ts:117, abilities/[name].ts:56).
findings.suggestion: Distinguish fetch errors from missing records (propagate or log), and unit-test that a failed fetch does not silently under-report the count.

findings.issue: Client-side column sorting (ascending-first flip, missing-values-last in both directions, aria-sort management) is untested DOM logic that acceptance tests only touch lightly.
findings.suggestion: Extract the row comparator into a pure function over cell values and test missing-last in both directions, numeric vs string columns, and the aria-sort flip.

findings.issue: Any API error (500, network blip) is rendered as a 404 'Not found' page; nothing tests that a transient upstream failure is distinguishable from a genuinely missing resource.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the error branch with a mocked ApiError of status 500 vs 404, and surface upstream failures as 502/500 rather than Not found.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled concurrency pool (acquire/release waiter queue) and cache rejection-eviction (:83-87) are untested; a release-path regression deadlocks every request after 24 in-flight.
findings.suggestion: Add a unit test driving >MAX_CONCURRENT fetches including rejections, asserting the pool drains and rejected promises are evicted from the cache.

findings.issue: latestFlavorText (last English entry, whitespace-run collapse) and humanize's capitalization rule are untested despite being used on every page and in search matching.
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests: 'mr-mime' → 'Mr Mime', '\f'/'\n' collapsing, entries with no English text.

summary: The agent shipped a working app with zero tests of its own: no runner, no script, no files. This is a missed opportunity because the riskiest logic (filtering, pagination, sorting, species mapping, URL state) is concentrated in small pure modules that node:test could cover without a browser. Once the acceptance suite stops being the only guard, silent-lossy error handling (.catch(() => null), API errors rendered as Not found) means regressions will render wrong counts and pages without anything failing loudly.
